key_insight: A roll-to-roll optical inline imaging setup can simultaneously and robustly measure multiple transparent or semi-transparent film thicknesses, and can also assess birefringence.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast, non-destructive in-process quality control for thin-film manufacturing in organic solar cell production and related coating lines.
method: Optical inline characterization in a roll-to-roll deposition environment
Simultaneous thickness resolution across free films and films on thicker transparent substrates
Applicable to transparent or semi-transparent layers, including PEDOT and ZnO
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-concept demonstration with thickness coverage from 0.3 to 110 micrometers on PEDOT and ZnO materials relevant to organic solar cells.
watch_item: Performance is shown as a proof of concept, so broader robustness across more materials, stack complexities, and production conditions should be validated before industrial deployment.
paper_title: Resolving multiple layer thicknesses and birefringence in thin films with an optical in-line Roll-to-Roll characterization setup
